content.text: A Festival Day – A Color – A Spirit VNNAAM PAD!

The staff, the Lt. Nai Plain Postman from many of the areas of the territory had gathered together, merging themselves into the dynamic Team Building, playing the whole thing, laughing the most and binding way ever.
Leading the show: MC Navy – power connection, air stir and create boom moments.
One day the party was closed, but the spirit of Dionysus Gifford – BREAKA – GEWN is still intact!
TodayTourist is honored to be a co-director of the Council of Commons on this meaningful day.
